# Gabriel Catimbang

Gabriel 'Gab' Catimbang — developer & DevOps engineer from Naga City, Philippines. I build websites people actually use, keep them alive, and win hackathons for fun.

Canonical: https://gabcat.dev/
Contact: https://gabcat.dev/contact
Email: catimbanggabriel@gmail.com

## Intro

It starts with a what if. I'm Gabriel Catimbang. I turn curiosity into things people use, and I build the pipelines that keep them running.

## About

Before writing code, Gabriel spent three years on the other side of a support chat at Bell Canada. That listening habit now sits behind full-stack products and the infrastructure that keeps them running.

## What I do

These days, I build it. And keep it alive. Four parts of the job, one habit behind all of them: listen first, then make it work.

### Build — It starts on a screen. It has to feel right.
I build the part people actually touch, front to back. Fast pages, calm interfaces, and code the next person can read without calling me.
Tools: Next.js, React, Vue & Nuxt, NestJS, TypeScript
MerchTrack had 2,750+ students in week one. The servers held, and so did I.

### Ship — Launch day should feel like any other day.
I like my deploys boring. So I wire up pipelines that test, build and ship on their own, on servers I can still reason about at 3 a.m.
Tools: Docker, AWS, GitHub Actions, Nginx, Linux
Detken moved production off Vercel onto servers we control.

### Store — Every app is a memory, really.
Somewhere, it has to remember who you are and what you did. I pick the right place to keep it, and shape it so it still makes sense a year from now.
Tools: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Convex
Games of the Generals keeps every move in sync, for every player.

### Play — And sometimes, I just play.
Game engines, AI, capture-the-flag forensics. The weekend detours are where most of my favourite what ifs come from.
Tools: Unreal Engine, C++, Gemini AI, CTF forensics
Hack4Gov regional CTF champion, 2024. Yes, it counts.

## Toolbox

- Building: Next.js, React, Vue & Nuxt, NestJS, TypeScript
- Keeping it alive: Docker, AWS, GitHub Actions, Nginx, Linux
- Remembering things: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Convex
- Curveballs: Unreal Engine, C++, Gemini AI, CTF forensics

## Selected work

### MerchTrack
University merch, minus the chaos.
An e-commerce platform for campus merchandise. 2,750+ students used it in the first week — the servers held, and so did I.
Tech: Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis
Link: https://github.com/gab-cat

### CS Guild
A digital home for computer studies students.
The hub where AdNU's computer studies community gathers — events, projects, and people. I lead the tech behind it as CTO.
Tech: Next.js, NestJS
Link: https://csguild.tech

### Games of the Generals
The classic Filipino strategy game, now online.
Real-time multiplayer for the board game every Filipino household argues over. Play your friends from anywhere.
Tech: Convex, Vite, Realtime
Link: https://github.com/gab-cat

### Your Daily Tarot
Your cards, read before your coffee.
A Messenger bot that deals you a daily tarot reading, written by AI with suspiciously good intuition.
Tech: Convex, Gemini, Messenger API
Link: https://github.com/gab-cat
